infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Edworld Co uses your camera to record mock interview practice answers for AI speech and presentation feedback.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Edworld Co uses your microphone to transcribe your interview answers and analyze speech pace and delivery metrics.
